extDescription.message: Fill logins, cards, and addresses from your Buddy vault. Requires the Buddy desktop app.

versionMismatch.message: This extension and the Buddy app are out of sync. Update both to the latest version to keep autofill working.

noLogins.message: No saved logins for this site

notInstalledHint.message: The extension doesn't have a vault of its own. Install the Buddy desktop app to get started.

pairWaiting.message: Approve the connection in the Buddy app…

onboardSub.message: A quick look at how it works.

onboardVaultTitle.message: Your vault stays in the desktop app

onboardVaultBody.message: This extension has no vault of its own. It asks the Buddy app you unlock, and only for the fields a page can actually fill.

onboardAccessBody.message: You can always fill from the toolbar. To fill logins on the page itself, allow site access.

optionsAccessOn.message: Buddy can show the picker on the sites you visit.

optionsAccessOff.message: Buddy only fills from the toolbar. Allow site access to get the in-page picker.

fillFramed.message: This site keeps its sign-in box in an embedded frame. Click the username field and pick from there.

fillNoField.message: No sign-in field found on this page.

fillAmbiguous.message: More than one sign-in form here. Click the field you want and pick from there.

commandOpenPicker.message: Open the Buddy fill list on the focused field

onboardDemoCaption.message: Click the Buddy mark inside a sign-in field, or press Ctrl+Shift+L, to see your saved logins.
